mapper.select: select dws_cr.id, #{dates} dates, q.register_dates, q.pkg, q.register_version, q.country, q.register_cohort_day cohort_day, q.cohort_user_num retention_user_num, IFNULL(d_user.user_num, 0) register_user_num, IFNULL(ROUND(q.cohort_user_num / IFNULL(d_user.user_num, 0), 8), 0) retention_rate from (select cohort_q.register_dates, cohort_q.pkg, cohort_q.register_version, cohort_q.country, cohort_q.register_cohort_day, COUNT(DISTINCT ulr.user_id) cohort_user_num FROM (SELECT dulr.`pkg`, dui.version register_version, dulr.`country`, dulr.`register_dates`, dulr.`register_cohort_day` FROM dwd_user_login_record dulr left join dim_user_info dui on dui.user_id = dulr.user_id WHERE dulr.dates = #{dates} GROUP BY dulr.`pkg`, dui.version, dulr.`country`, dulr.`register_dates`, dulr.`register_cohort_day`) cohort_q INNER JOIN dwd_user_login_record ulr ON (cohort_q.pkg = ulr.pkg and cohort_q.`register_version` = ulr.register_version and cohort_q.`country` = ulr.country and cohort_q.`register_dates` = ulr.register_dates and cohort_q.register_cohort_day = ulr.register_cohort_day) GROUP BY cohort_q.pkg, cohort_q.`register_version`, cohort_q.`country`, cohort_q.`register_dates`, cohort_q.register_cohort_day) q LEFT JOIN dws_daily_package_cohort_retention dws_cr on (q.register_dates = dws_cr.register_dates and q.register_version = dws_cr.register_version and q.country = dws_cr.country and q.pkg = dws_cr.pkg and q.register_cohort_day = dws_cr.cohort_day) INNER JOIN dws_daily_package_register d_user on (q.register_dates = d_user.dates and q.register_version = d_user.version and q.country = d_user.country and q.pkg = d_user.pkg)
